_comment: Copy to rcon-servers.json and edit. One entry per server the bot may drive. `allow` is REQUIRED: RCON is console-level, so anyone on that list can /fill and /remove anything - leave it empty and the bot refuses every builder. `operators` may remove other people's builds (defaults to the first allow entry). `password` may be ${ENV_VAR}. `log` and the world dir are paths INSIDE the bot container - see compose.yml. `readVersion` is the minecraft-data registry used to read schematics (see src/version.js).
